o1: Contributes to microtubule severing ATPase activity. Predicted to enable microtubule binding. Involved in embryo development; meiotic spindle organization, including oocyte meiotic spindle formation; microtubule depolymerization; and microtubule severing. Is located in cytoplasm; nucleus; and spindle pole. Is part of katanin complex. Is expressed in germ line. Interacts with MEI-1.
